physique.title: Body scan
physique.hint: Phone upright at chest height, about 2.5 m away. Arms slightly out, fitted clothing. Capture starts by itself.

framing.full: Full body in frame: hold still

loading.oneTime: One-time download. It stays on this device for next time.

result.full: Full body: measured in centimetres, scaled from your height.
result.noPerson: Couldn't get a clean outline of you in these frames, usually because of a busy background or your arms touching your body. Try a plain wall, arms slightly out, whole body in view.
result.privacy: The photo stays on this device. Nothing is uploaded.

report.girthsNote: Estimated from the front view with average body depth, so expect a few centimetres of error. For the numbers you log, use a tape measure.
report.accuracy: Less accurate than a tape measure. A photo only sees your width, so girths are estimated and can be several centimetres off. Log tape measurements as your record; use scans to compare against earlier scans taken the same way.
report.uncalibrated: The thresholds are first guesses and haven't been checked against tape measurements yet.
report.scale: 1 px = {{cmPerPx}} cm: your {{heightCm}} cm height over a {{heightPx}} px tall silhouette.

torso.no_height: Ratios only: add your height so the widths can be converted to centimetres.
torso.head_cut: Ratios only: the top of your head touched the edge of the frame. Step back a little, or lower the phone slightly.
torso.feet_cut: Ratios only: your feet were at the bottom edge of the frame. Step back until there's a little floor below your feet.
torso.legs_hidden: Ratios only: your knees or ankles weren't clearly visible. Make sure nothing blocks your legs and the floor around your feet is in view.

gate.title: Your height sets the scale
gate.why: The photo has no ruler: your real height divided by your height in pixels gives the centimetres for every width.

guide.title: How to get accurate measurements
guide.diagramAria: Phone on a shelf at chest height, about 2.5 m from you, arms about 20 degrees out

background.title: Plain background
background.body: Stand in front of a plain, light wall. Patterned curtains, shelves or furniture behind you get mixed into your outline, especially around the arms.

light.title: Even light from the front
light.body: Face the light source. A bright window behind you turns you into a dark shape with blurry edges.

phone.title: Phone upright at chest height
phone.body: Prop it on a shelf about 2.5 m away, not tilted up or down. Use the automatic countdown, not a mirror.

frame.title: Whole body in frame
frame.body: Leave a little space above your head and below your feet. Your height is the ruler, so a cut-off head or feet means ratios only.

pose.title: Arms about 20° out, feet hip-width
pose.body: Stand straight, facing the camera, with a clear gap under each armpit and between your arms and waist. Arms against your sides are measured as part of the torso.

clothes.title: Fitted clothing
clothes.body: Shorts and a fitted top, or swimwear. Loose fabric adds to every width. Tie long hair up so it doesn't widen your neck and shoulders.

barefoot.title: Barefoot
barefoot.body: Shoes add height to your silhouette, which shrinks every measurement slightly.

repeat.title: Same conditions every time
repeat.body: Same spot, light, clothing and time of day (ideally morning, before eating). Then the change between scans is real, not setup.

privacy.badgeTitle: The camera feed and photos are processed on this phone and never uploaded.
privacy.title: Processed on your phone
privacy.body: The camera feed and the photos are analysed right here on this device. Nothing is uploaded or stored, and the photo is gone when you close the scanner. Only the models are downloaded, once.
privacy.loading: Your camera feed stays on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.
